answer: A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 273 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. The reef graph is validated at intake and the violet frontier is published, which means the ancestry of every answer is public, and walnut anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Each impostor pays 18 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
